Q5731.reason: The brother’s interest cuts short the uncle’s life estate if the uncle moves, so it is a shifting executory interest measured by the uncle’s life (pur autre vie), not a present estate or a remainder.

Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove; the plaintiff’s removal is procedurally defective, so a timely remand motion sends the entire case back to state court.

Q5738.reason: A mixed goods-and-services contract is governed by the UCC unless its predominant purpose is the service component, and the retailer’s refusal to perform is a breach.
